Name: My Dear Emily
Author: Miricancan
Description:
[size=4][b]描述[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]請描述您的模組的主要目的[/color][/size]
[font=serif][b][i][size=4]My Dear Emily[/size][/i][/b]
This mod adds hundreds of brand-new romance-oriented dialogues for Emily.
This mod contains a small amount of adult-suggestive content — very mild — but you can disable it at any time under [b][i]Game Menu → Settings → Mod Settings → My Dear Emily[/i][/b]. You can also select your preferred language there. The mod defaults to [b]English[/b] and currently supports [b]English[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b].
To access the mod settings menu, please make sure you have[u] [b]GMCM[/b][/u] installed.
[/font]
[line]
[font=serif][b]Why choose this mod?[/b]
Every line of dialogue has been carefully crafted, refined with AI assistance, and reviewed by hand to ensure the best possible experience. Compared to the vanilla game, these dialogues are richer, more intimate, and truer to Emily's character — while bringing out more of her personal charm.
The dialogue also changes based on the progression of your relationship with Emily. Different seasons and festivals bring their own unique conversations, [color=#a64d79]making your romance feel more real and more alive.[/color][/font]

[b][size=4][font=serif]My Dear Emily[/font][/size][/b]
这个模组为艾米莉加入了上百组全新的爱情向对话。
本模组含有少量成人向暗示内容，十分清淡，但你仍然可以选择在[b]游戏菜单 → 设置 → 模组设置 → My Dear Emily[/b] 中将其关闭。同时，你也可以在此处选择语言。模组的默认语言为[b]英语[/b]，目前支持[b]英语[/b]与[b]简体中文[/b]。
若要使用模组设置菜单，请务必确保已下载 [b]GMCM[/b]。
[line]
[b]为什么选择这个模组？[/b]
我们的对话内容经过反复斟酌，并以 AI 工具润色、人工审核，力求最佳体验。这些对话相比原版更加丰富、亲密，在贴合人物性格的同时充分体现艾米莉的个人魅力。
根据玩家与艾米莉的关系进展，对话内容各不相同；在不同的季节与节日，也备有专属对话。让你体验更真实、更亲密的恋爱。
[size=4][b]安裝說明[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]詳細說明使用者安裝您的模組必須遵循的步驟。[/color][/size]
[b]English:[/b]
[line]

[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu — for language and content settings[/*]

[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]

[*]Place the
[code]MyDearEmily[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]directory.[/*]

[/list][b]Configuration[/b] (requires Generic Mod Config Menu)
[list]
[*][b]Language[/b]: English / 中文[/*]
[*][b]Adult Content[/b]: On / Off (default: On)[/*]
[/list][line]
